entries.strategyName: Order, invoice, and settle in one write
notes: Draft challenger aligned to the trusted 5-call exact-match path for Task 11.
Resolve payment type before invoicing and attempt settlement during PUT /order/{id}/:invoice.
Manual disposable-fixture sandbox verification on 2026-03-21 proved the customer-payment branch end-to-end: a one-row CSV payment settled a real sandbox invoice from outstanding 1000 to 0.
The first manual sandbox attempt exposed a correctness bug: GET /supplierInvoice without invoiceDateFrom/invoiceDateTo returned 422. The current strategy now includes those required date bounds.

For the exact one-row incoming customer-payment shape, the challenger used 6 calls while the checked-in payment playbooks prove a 3-call lower bound: GET /invoice -> GET /invoice/paymentType -> PUT /invoice/{id}/:payment.
Supplier-payment and manual-voucher branches are not yet sandbox-verified.
